journeyTemplate.blurb: Book a time with me and do your interview with Claude. Those two get everything else moving.

milestones.detail: About an hour, to go through this whole list together. Pick any time this week that suits you.
milestones.notePrompt: Anything you want to cover when we meet? (optional)
steps: Pick a time on the booking page below. You get a calendar invite straight away.
Bring anything you already have: your ABN, your Working With Children Check, your insurance.
milestones.title: Book a time with me this week

milestones.detail: About an hour, whenever suits you, out loud. It's a spoken chat with Claude, like a phone call: it asks one question at a time, and you just talk. Stories are gold. Say "skip" for anything you don't want to answer. How to start is below, then the questions, so you can think ahead. Your words become the website, the ads and the posts.
milestones.notePrompt: Or paste the link Claude gives you when you tap Share
steps: Open the Claude app on your phone and start a new chat. Paste in the message I sent you on WhatsApp, and send it.
Tap the voice button: the little sound-wave next to the microphone, in the box where you type. Say hello. Claude talks back and asks the first question.
At the end, Claude asks you to close voice mode and type: write it out. It then writes the whole interview down. Tap Share and paste the link below.

YOU AND WHY. 1. What happened in your own life that led you to counselling? 2. When did you first think, "kids this little need this"? Tell me about that moment. 3. What does ROR (Raw, Open, Ready) mean to you? 4. What do you wish you'd known when your boys were 4 to 6?

THE PARENTS YOU'RE FOR. 5. Describe the parent who walks in your door. What's their week like? 6. What do parents say to you when they're at the end of their rope? Their actual words. 7. What have they usually tried already that hasn't worked? 8. What are parents scared of, or embarrassed about, when it comes to their child's big feelings? 9. What do they want to feel by the end of a term?

THE KIDS. 10. Tell me about a "spicy" child, a "sparkly" child, an "energy bunny" and a quiet one. How does each one show big feelings? 11. What does a shy child need on their first day? 12. What's a moment with a child you'll never forget? (No names.)

THE TOOLS AND THE CLASS. 13. Walk me through a class, from the moment they arrive to the moment they leave. 14. Pick 3 tools. For each one: what's it called, what's it for, and how would you explain it to a 4-year-old? 15. Why play, clay and paint, and not sitting down and talking? 16. Why two weeks per tool? Why a term at a time? 17. What goes in the take-home guide? What should a parent do with it?

TRUST AND THE HARD QUESTIONS. 18. How is this different from therapy? When would you send a family somewhere else? 19. What would you say to a parent who thinks their child is "too much" for a group? 20. What can a parent honestly expect after one term? What won't change? 21. How do you keep kids safe and the room calm with 10 little ones?

QUICK-FIRE. 22. Finish this: "Tiny ROR is for the parent who…" 23. Finish this: "Let them ror means…" 24. One thing a parent could try tonight with a big feeling. How would you teach it in 30 seconds? 25. Anything I haven't asked that parents should know?
milestones.title: Your interview with Claude

uploadOptions.hint: Only if you saved the interview as a file. The Share link below is easier.
uploadOptions.title: Upload the interview

journeyTemplate.name: Start here

journeyTemplate.blurb: These come first because some of them have a wait built in. You own every account, in your name. You add me as a helper and I do the fiddly parts. Never send me a password.

milestones.detail: Your ABN, and the name the business trades under. Is it ROR The Journey? You need the ABN for the domain name too.
milestones.notePrompt: Your ABN and the business name
milestones.title: Your ABN and business name

milestones.detail: Two-step login means Facebook asks for a code from your phone as well as your password. Meta needs it on before you can add me to anything. Two minutes, in the Facebook app.
milestones.notePrompt: Stuck, or can't find it on your phone? Tell me where (optional)
steps: Open the Facebook app and tap the menu, then Settings & privacy, then Settings.
Tap Accounts Centre, then Password and security, then Two-factor authentication.
Choose your Facebook account, pick text message or an app, and follow the prompts.
milestones.title: Turn on two-step login on Facebook

milestones.detail: Meta is the company behind Facebook and Instagram. A business account is the folder your Facebook page, your Instagram and your ads sit in. It's free, and it's in your name. Open it this week: ads from a brand-new account start with a low daily limit that only lifts with time.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: Stuck, or can't find it on your phone? Tell me where (optional)
steps: Go to business.facebook.com and log in with your own Facebook.
Press Create an account. Use the business name, your name and your email.
Confirm the email Meta sends you.
milestones.title: Open your Meta business account

milestones.detail: One partner request lets me post, and make and run your ads, from my own login. Everything stays in your account, in your name. I do the fiddly set-up after this: the ad account, linking your page and Instagram, and the tracking. You approve every ad.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: Stuck, or can't find it on your phone? Tell me where and we'll do it on a call (optional)
steps: In business.facebook.com, open Settings, then Users, then Partners.
Press Add, then "Give a partner access to your assets".
Type my Business ID. I'll message it to you.
Tick everything it offers (your page, your Instagram, your ad account), choose full control, then press Assign assets.
milestones.title: Add me as a partner on Meta

milestones.detail: The ads are paid for on your own card, so the spend is always yours to see and stop. I'll tell you when the ad account is ready. Meta may take a small test payment and give it back. Nothing is spent on ads until you say go, and I set a daily cap first.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: Stuck, or can't find it on your phone? Tell me where (optional)
steps: In business.facebook.com, open Billing and payments.
Choose the Tiny ROR ad account, then Add payment method.
Add your card. If it asks about tax, enter your ABN.
milestones.title: Add your card for the ads

milestones.detail: A fresh Tiny ROR Instagram, just for families from Byron Bay to Ballina, and a Facebook page. We open them together, about ten minutes. The Instagram needs to be a professional account, joined to the Facebook page, so ads can run on both. If you're happy for me to reuse posts from your ROR The Journey pages, paste those links too.
milestones.notePrompt: Your Instagram and Facebook links
steps: In the Instagram app, open Settings, then Account type and tools, and switch to a professional account. Choose Business.
Still in Instagram, tap Edit profile, then Page, and connect your Tiny ROR Facebook page.
Paste both links in the box below.
milestones.title: Your Tiny ROR Instagram and Facebook page

milestones.detail: Porkbun is where your web addresses and your website will live from now on. Open an account at porkbun.com, in your name, with your own email and card. It's yours. I never log in to it.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
steps: Go to porkbun.com and create an account.
Turn on two-step login when it offers it.
milestones.title: Open your own Porkbun account

milestones.detail: A new web address just for Tiny ROR. I suggest tinyror.com.au. A .com.au needs your ABN. We buy it together, in your Porkbun account, so it's in your name. I do the technical set-up after that.
milestones.notePrompt: Another name you'd prefer? (optional)
milestones.title: Buy your new Tiny ROR web address

milestones.detail: Stripe takes the parents' payments and pays them straight into your bank account. Set it up yourself at stripe.com, in the business name. Have your ABN, your licence or passport, a bill or statement with your home address, and your bank details ready. Stripe checks them, usually within a day. Later you connect it to the booking page yourself, with me on a call.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.title: Your own Stripe account

milestones.detail: Your Google Business Profile is how you show on the map in Ballina. It's free. Add me as a manager, so I can check it and fill it in. If you don't have a listing yet, tell me in the box and we'll make one together.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: No listing yet, or not sure? Tell me here (optional)
steps: Signed in to Google, search for your business name.
On your listing, press the three dots, then Business Profile settings.
Choose People and access, then Add.
Type jesse@allconvos.ai, choose Manager, and send the invite.
milestones.title: Add me to your Google listing

milestones.detail: Your current website and its web address live at Wix. We're moving both to Porkbun. Invite me to your Wix site, so I can copy the site across. You invite me from inside Wix. I never need your login.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
steps: Log in to Wix and open your site's dashboard.
Go to Settings, then Roles & Permissions.
Press Invite People, and type jesse@allconvos.ai.
Choose the Admin role, then send the invite.
milestones.title: Add me to your Wix site

milestones.detail: The mobile number parents can message on WhatsApp, and the email address that replies come back to. They go on the website and on every message sent in your name.
milestones.notePrompt: The mobile number and the email address
milestones.title: The phone and email parents will see

journeyTemplate.blurb: How your classes work, the prices, a few local parents I can talk to, and your yes on the quiz and the ads. Nothing goes out in your name without it.

milestones.detail: About an hour, to go through this whole list together. Pick any time this week that suits you.
milestones.notePrompt: Anything you want to cover when we meet? (optional)

milestones.detail: About an hour, whenever suits you, out loud. It's a spoken chat with Claude, like a phone call: it asks one question at a time, and you just talk. Stories are gold. Say "skip" for anything you don't want to answer. How to start is below, then the questions, so you can think ahead. Your words become the website, the ads and the posts.
milestones.notePrompt: Or paste the link Claude gives you when you tap Share
steps: Open the Claude app on your phone and start a new chat. Paste in the message I sent you on WhatsApp, and send it.
Tap the voice button: the little sound-wave next to the microphone, in the box where you type. Say hello. Claude talks back and asks the first question.
At the end, Claude asks you to close voice mode and type: write it out. It then writes the whole interview down. Tap Share and paste the link below.

YOU AND WHY. 1. What happened in your own life that led you to counselling? 2. When did you first think, "kids this little need this"? Tell me about that moment. 3. What does ROR (Raw, Open, Ready) mean to you? 4. What do you wish you'd known when your boys were 4 to 6?

THE PARENTS YOU'RE FOR. 5. Describe the parent who walks in your door. What's their week like? 6. What do parents say to you when they're at the end of their rope? Their actual words. 7. What have they usually tried already that hasn't worked? 8. What are parents scared of, or embarrassed about, when it comes to their child's big feelings? 9. What do they want to feel by the end of a term?

THE KIDS. 10. Tell me about a "spicy" child, a "sparkly" child, an "energy bunny" and a quiet one. How does each one show big feelings? 11. What does a shy child need on their first day? 12. What's a moment with a child you'll never forget? (No names.)

THE TOOLS AND THE CLASS. 13. Walk me through a class, from the moment they arrive to the moment they leave. 14. Pick 3 tools. For each one: what's it called, what's it for, and how would you explain it to a 4-year-old? 15. Why play, clay and paint, and not sitting down and talking? 16. Why two weeks per tool? Why a term at a time? 17. What goes in the take-home guide? What should a parent do with it?

TRUST AND THE HARD QUESTIONS. 18. How is this different from therapy? When would you send a family somewhere else? 19. What would you say to a parent who thinks their child is "too much" for a group? 20. What can a parent honestly expect after one term? What won't change? 21. How do you keep kids safe and the room calm with 10 little ones?

QUICK-FIRE. 22. Finish this: "Tiny ROR is for the parent who…" 23. Finish this: "Let them ror means…" 24. One thing a parent could try tonight with a big feeling. How would you teach it in 30 seconds? 25. Anything I haven't asked that parents should know?
milestones.title: Your interview with Claude

tror-wix.detail: Your current website and its web address live at Wix. We're moving both to Porkbun. Invite me to your Wix site, so I can copy the site across. You invite me from inside Wix. I never need your login.

tror-wwcc.detail: Your WWCC number goes on the website. Parents look for it.
